Are you a recent computer science graduate or have hands-on experience working with C# .NET and SQL? Would you like to apply your skills to make a positive impact on health and quality of life within the pharmaceutical industry? Do you value working creatively and independently?

If so, we are looking for a motivated Associate Software Engineer to join our Systems Engineering team and you could be our ideal candidate! This role is perfect for somebody eager to learn, contribute to real production systems and continuously develop their technical skills with the support of experienced engineers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supporting the Systems Engineering team in the development, testing and maintenance of internal applications and services.
  • Collaborating with project managers, business units and the Systems Engineering team to deliver new features, improvements, troubleshooting and debugging of issues.
  • Writing clean, maintainable, test-driven and well-documented code following team standards and best practices.
  • Contribute to testing, documentation and challenging development processes for continuous development.
  • Provide technical support for systems within the Systems Engineering remit.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, Diploma or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrable experience of full-stack development in C# .NET Framework / Core, ASP.NET MVC / Razor, HTML, CSS3 and JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with software development IDEs (e.g. Visual Studio and VS Code) and version control tools (e.g. Git).
  • Understanding of basic data structure and object-oriented development principles.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, critical thinking skills and good attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, prioritisation skills and the ability work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Enthusiasm for keeping up to date with developments in process and software engineering methods and technologies.

Desired Skills

  • Experience of 1- 2 Years is preferred
  • Demonstrable experience in T-SQL and SQL Server.
  • Understanding and/or experience of cloud computing platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS).
  • Exposure to development management tools (e.g. Azure DevOps or Jira).
  • Knowledge of development methodologies (e.g. Scrum or Agile).
  • Experience with workflow automation platforms (e.g. Power Automate).
  • Knowledge of computerised system validation concepts.

Other Requirements

  • Fluent in spoken and written English.
  • Must be available to work within CET / GMT business hours.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

Our Culture

Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer (EMEA) at Quantum Metric, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor supporting complex, high-value sales opportunities across the region. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.

In this role, you will guide the technical strategy for enterprise deals, aligning Quantum Metric’s platform with strategic business initiatives. You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Advisory: Guide the technical strategy for enterprise sales cycles across EMEA, from initial discovery to closing.

  • Solution Design: Create tailored demonstrations and narratives that align Quantum Metric’s platform with high-level business outcomes.

  • POC Execution: Lead complex proof-of-concepts, defining success criteria and quantifying measurable business value.

  • Technical Architecture: Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures and clear value propositions.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives on deal orchestration and coordinate with Product/Engineering to ensure smooth post-sales onboarding.

  • Market Influence: Support RFP responses and provide structured customer feedback to influence the product roadmap.

Requirements

  • Linguistic Skills: Proficiency in English and Italian; additional European languages preferred.

  • Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering within the SaaS or software sector.

  • Sales Acumen: Proven success supporting complex, multi-layered sales cycles for large enterprise organizations.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to engage both technical teams (architects/developers) and C-suite executives (CIO/CDO).

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and ROI-based solutioning.

  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills tailored for diverse corporate environments.

  • Agility: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple strategic deals and a willingness to travel 25–30% across EMEA.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Digital Experience Analytics or CXM platforms.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI, enterprise data architecture, or tagging strategies.

  • Background in high-growth SaaS or digital transformation consulting.

70,000 - 95,000 GBP basic + variable

Encouraging and collaborative culture

About Quantum Metric

As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. Providing a simplified approach to monitor, diagnose and optimize the digital journeys that matter most, the Quantum Metric platform offers in-depth customer understanding, quantified and tied to core business objectives.

Today, Quantum Metric captures insights from 50 percent of the world’s internet users, supporting nationally recognized brands in ecommerce and retail, travel, financial services and telecommunications.

Quantum Metric has been named to the Inc 5000 and the Deloitte 500 for the last six-consecutive years, and has made the Best Places to Work lists by Glassdoor, BuiltIn, Fast Company and Forbes.

Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Application Engineer is a key technical role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring successful configuration, deployment, and value realization of Litmus products for customers across EMEA.

The Application Engineer will work with prospective and existing customers during proof-of-concept projects and production implementations, validating requirements, developing best-practice configurations, and delivering technical outcomes that demonstrate measurable business value.

The Application Engineer will also partner closely with Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, and the Litmus Support Desk to support pre-sales transitions, customer expansion, product feedback, and Level 2 technical support. This role reports to the Director of Technical Delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Validate customer requirements for proof-of-concept and production implementations of Litmus products.

  • Configure Litmus products during proof-of-concepts, customer pilots, and production deployments.

  • Lead assigned technical implementation activities and ensure contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.

  • Develop innovative solution approaches that help customers maximize value from Litmus products.

  • Maintain and contribute to internal solution libraries, deployment best practices, reusable configurations, and technical documentation.

  • Provide Level 2 technical support to the Litmus Service Desk, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and customer issue resolution.

  • Support Sales Engineers and Account Managers with technical architecture reviews, proposal inputs, RFI/RFP responses, demonstrations, and smooth pre-sales-to-implementation handovers.

  • Provide field feedback to Product Management and Development on customer requirements, market gaps, bugs, and product enhancement opportunities.

  • Support webinars, customer meetings, partner enablement, value-added reseller discussions, and customer user group activities as required.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • Professional experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment, ideally in an Application Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation, Controls, Industrial IT/OT, or related technical role.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or supporting software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, or shop-floor solutions in a manufacturing environment.

  • Strong technical understanding of network protocols, system architecture, Linux-based systems, databases, and customer deployment environments.

  • Experience with product configuration, technical troubleshooting, and customer-facing implementation or technical support activities.

  • Working knowledge of scripting or coding using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.

  • Understanding of containerized and cloud/hybrid infrastructure technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work directly with customers, internal technical teams, sales teams, and partners.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment.

  • Fluency in German & English

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Litmus products, industrial data platforms, OPC/UA, PLC/SCADA systems, or edge connectivity use cases.

  • Exposure to pre-sales support, solution demonstrations, technical proposal review, RFI/RFP participation, or customer expansion activities.

  • Experience supporting partners, value-added resellers, webinars, customer focus groups, or user-group events.

  • Ability to translate field observations into clear product feedback, enhancement requests, and best-practice documentation.

  • Experience working with industrial protocols, connectivity standards, or OT/IT environments.

  • Enjoys solving complex technical problems, learning new technologies, and helping customers realize measurable business value.

As a Lead Frontend Engineer (m/f/d), you will be a key driver in shaping and evolving our web platform in a dynamic, technology-driven environment. You are comfortable working across architecture, hands-on development, and the continuous improvement of our applications, with a strong focus on quality, scalability, performance, and user experience.
At the intersection of Frontend Engineering, Backend, Product, and Platform, you will take technical ownership of key areas of our web platform. You will build high-performance, scalable, and user-centric solutions, actively shape our frontend architecture, and ensure sustainable technical decisions.
In this role, you will act as a technical leader and trusted sparring partner within the team. You challenge existing solutions, contribute ideas proactively, and help drive architecture, technology, and quality decisions. At the same time, you remain hands-on and work closely with the team to implement key initiatives. Your tasks:

Frontend Development & Architecture

  • Develop and maintain the frontend of our web platform using React and TypeScript
  • Contribute to architecture and design decisions for a modular and future-proof platform
  • Build reusable components, frontend modules, and backend-for-frontend solutions
  • Evolve our application architecture with a focus on maintainability, scalability, and performance
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs using Node.js and NestJS
  • Work in an agile team with close collaboration across Product, Backend, and Platform teams
Product, Quality & Automation
  • Deliver complex use cases with a strong focus on user experience and consistency
  • Translate business and design requirements into sustainable technical solutions
  • Design and implement modern testing and quality assurance strategies
  • Conduct code reviews and continuously improve code quality and maintainability
  • Drive automation, developer experience, and engineering standards
  • Continuously optimize frontend performance and overall user experience
AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation
  • Leverage modern AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar solutions as part of the daily development workflow
  • Ensure the quality, security, and maintainability of AI-assisted software development
  • Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and engineering approaches
  • Contribute to our technical roadmap and AI-assisted engineering best practices
Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to frontend engineers and adjacent teams
  • Help define architecture principles, quality standards, and engineering best practices
  • Support the team with complex technical challenges
  • Facilitate technical decision-making and collaborate closely with Product Management, Backend Engineering, and Platform teams


Your profile

Your Way of Working

  • You are solution-oriented and able to communicate complex technical topics in a structured way
  • You think beyond individual features and design solutions with scalability, maintainability, and user value in mind
  • You challenge architectures and processes constructively and actively seek better solutions
  • You communicate your ideas proactively and can explain technical decisions clearly
  • You take ownership and drive topics independently from concept to delivery

Vous êtes-vous déjà demandé ce qu'il se passe au moment où vous validez votre paiement en magasin ou en ligne ?

C’est (en partie) Lyra, qui se cache derrière ! Comment ? En sécurisant vos transactions et en s'assurant qu'elles transitent. Nos solutions s’adaptent à tous les besoins paiement (marketplace, mobilité, omnicanalité, initiation de paiement, etc.) et pour tous types de clients (e-commerçants, retailers, banques, etc.).

Et c'est en 2001 que l'aventure commence. L'ouverture à la concurrence du réseau des communications nous permet d'entrer dans le monde du paiement avec un objectif : le révolutionner grâce à de nouvelles technologies et un business model novateur. Rapidement, nous devenons leader dans la sécurisation des paiements grâce à notre propre technologie made in France. En 2009, nous développons notre service de paiement en ligne et en 2018, nous lançons notre établissement de paiement : Lyra Collect.

Notre promesse ? Faire de chaque paiement une petite révolution, en phase avec les dernières tendances de consommation et les avancées technologiques. Notre secret ? Plus de 20 ans d’expertise, qui font que, aujourd’hui, il y a une chance sur deux pour que nos chemins se croisent lors d’une transaction en France ou à l’international.

Mission

Chez Lyra, nos back-offices donnent accès à la visualisation et la gestion de nos paiements e-commerce. Nous souhaitons faire évoluer ces interfaces pour en faciliter l’utilisation au quotidien et améliorer leur réactivité. Cette refonte porte notamment sur la clarté des écrans, la cohérence visuelle et la fluidité des parcours.

Le projet associe une refonte du front-end en React à une réflexion sur l’efficacité du back-end Java EE et Spring Boot. La réactivité des interfaces dépend aussi des services qui les alimentent : il s’agit donc d’analyser les traitements et les accès aux données pour identifier les améliorations possibles, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec notre UX Designer

Vous intégrez une équipe composée d'une dizaine de développeurs. Au quotidien, vous :

  • Analysez l’existant pour comprendre le fonctionnement de nos back-offices et identifier les axes d’amélioration,
  • Participez à la réflexion sur les nouvelles interfaces, en prenant en compte leur ergonomie et leur cohérence visuelle,
  • Développer les interfaces en React et assurer leur intégration avec les services back-end,
  • Contribuez à l’analyse des problèmes de performance, notamment sur les temps de réponse, les traitements et les accès aux données,
  • Participez à la définition et à la mise en œuvre d’optimisations du back-end Java EE et Spring Boot, avec l’appui de l’équipe,
  • Créez ou adaptez les tests pour vérifier les évolutions réalisées et prévenir les régressions,
  • Rédigez la documentation technique associée à vos développements.

  • Front-end : React
  • Environnement JavaScript : Node.js
  • Données : MariaDB, OpenSearch
  • Outils de build : Maven, Gradle

The team

To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team. This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms.   • Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients.

  • The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations.

Ship faster and more confidently with global coverage across 600,000+ devices, 800+ payment methods, 150+ countries, and 100+ languages. To learn more, visit www.testlio.com.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that owns every way the outside world connects to Testlio: our partner integrations, our public API, our identity and access surfaces. If a client’s Jira, a client’s CI pipeline, a client’s engineer, or a client’s AI agent touches Testlio, it goes through your team’s systems. This role reports to the Director, Engineering.

Why will you love this job?

  • Own the platform’s contract with the world. You’ll lead the one team that covers the whole programmatic perimeter: bi-directional sync with a dozen tools (Jira, Xray, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Asana, Linear, Monday, TestRail, Trello, YouTrack, Slack), enterprise SSO, our public API.
  • Build the API as a product, not a byproduct. We have a written public-API strategy: OpenAPI contracts as the source of truth, major and dated versioning, uniform auth, granular API roles, rate limiting, end-to-end request tracing.
  • Make support self-serve. You’ll cut recurring support work at the source, with self-serve setup and diagnostics, integration health visible to the people who need it, and automation and permanent fixes instead of repeat manual triage.
  • Partner with product and with real customers. You’ll work closely with a dedicated product manager on discovery, prioritization, and outcomes, and also directly with enterprise client engineering teams who build against our API.

Why will you love being a part of Testlio?

  • Great Culture: Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network.
  • Remote Work: Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team. Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace.
  • Investment in You: Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development.
  • Winning Business: Testlio is growing, profitable, and cash-strong. We are leading our industry with exceptional clients who provide us with a high NPS score and a 4.7 rating on G2. Our business model is global, enterprise, and subscription-based. Several of our largest clients have been with us for 7+ years, and many spend $500K+/year with Testlio.

What would your day look like?

Shaping what's next

  • Stay close to the code: Expect to spend roughly 20–30% of your time on hands-on engineering, including writing production code, providing substantive reviews on critical-path pull requests, and signing off on key technical designs. You'll help remove critical technical bottlenecks and contribute directly when needed, while empowering the team to own and deliver work independently.
  • Public API strategy: Own Testlio's public API end to end: OpenAPI specifications kept current in every service repo and treated as the consumer contract, a coherent versioning and deprecation policy, consistent authentication and authorization on every endpoint, rate limiting, and traceability across the request path.
  • Integration architecture: Set the multi-quarter technical direction for a sync platform that must stay correct across a dozen third-party APIs, each with its own data model, rate limits, and release cadence. Reduce per-vendor special-casing in favour of a common mapping and sync core.
  • Roadmap ownership: Turn strategy into a sequenced roadmap with your product partner, and own technical delivery from concept to production.

Running it with rigor

  • Engineering operating rhythm: Establish effective planning, prioritization, and design review practices that balance delivery speed with long-term scalability.
  • Technical leadership: Combine engineering vision and team mentorship with hands-on technical contribution, staying close to the codebase to understand the team's work and make informed technical decisions.
  • Third-party dependency management: Own the risk that comes with depending on other people's APIs. Track vendor changelogs, deprecations and sunset dates, plan migrations before they become incidents, and keep credential, token, and connection failures from turning into client-visible outages.
  • Production support and escalations: Own production support for your domains, including triage, escalation management, and root-cause resolution. Drive automation, self-serve setup, and permanent fixes that measurably reduce recurring support volume and improve operational efficiency.
  • Reliability and observability: Define service level objectives for sync freshness, sync success rate, and API availability and latency; build the dashboards that make integration health self-serve; and lead root-cause analysis on production issues.Engineering standards: Ensure work is traceable and the Definition of Done is consistently met, minimizing escaped defects and keeping cloud costs in check.
  • Team growth: Coach engineers technically, bring AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code) into daily practice, and reduce knowledge silos through reviews and documentation.

What do you need to succeed?

Technical skills

  • Engineering management: 5+ years managing a team of 4+ engineers in an agile, remote environment.
  • Hands-on technical leadership: Recent experience writing production code and designing or evolving production systems. You are comfortable working directly in the codebase, contributing to implementation, reviewing code, and making architectural decisions alongside your team.
  • Public or partner-facing API ownership: Proven experience designing, versioning, documenting, and deprecating APIs consumed by people outside your own company. You've made a breaking-change decision and lived with the consequences. OpenAPI, idempotency, pagination, webhooks, and rate limiting are familiar ground.
  • Third-party integration systems: Experience building or running integrations against external APIs at scale: OAuth flows, credential storage and rotation, retries and backoff, queue and poison-message handling, conflict resolution in bi-directional sync, and per-tenant blast-radius control.
  • Technical stack: Strong affinity with TypeScript and Node.js on AWS, including serverless (Lambda), DynamoDB, and event-driven patterns.

Nice-to-haves

  • Identity and access: Practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and enterprise SSO, plus token scoping and least-privilege API roles.
  • Broader stack familiarity: Kafka, GraphQL, Python, and React are a plus.
  • Observability and performance: Experience with observability and APM tools (e.g., New Relic, Datadog, Sentry) and optimizing slow database transactions.
  • Application security: Knowledge of application security best practices and integrating security review into the SDLC.
  • Legacy modernization: Experience modernizing legacy systems or paying down significant technical debt while keeping a product running.
  • SaaS experience: Prior experience managing a SaaS product is a plus.

Human skills

  • Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Collaborative. Works effectively with product management and cross-functional partners in a distributed, asynchronous setting.
  • Organized and thorough, with a meticulous approach to standards and process.
  • Growth catalyst. Passionate about team productivity, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Results-oriented, with data-driven decision-making.

What is the application process?

We do our best to bring on individuals who are excited about their role and have the potential for a great future with Testlio. Since we are 100% distributed, you'll meet with several people from our organization so you get a clear picture of who you'd work with and what the role expects. Our process typically takes 3 to 4 weeks.

  • Application review
  • Recruiter interview
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Live Technical Exercise
  • 2 team and stakeholder interviews
  • Reference checks
  • Offer

Diversity and inclusion

Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and 46% of our team members identify as women. For more information, see the DEI section of our website.

Who this role is for

You are probably senior at a scale-up or a larger company today. You may have recently moved into a management track and found that you miss building, or you may be at the point where the next step is leading people and you want that step to come with code still attached.


This is that role. You lead, you set direction, you own the relationship with the rest of the business, and you stay hands-on. If you want to run a large organisation, we are too small for you. If you want to stop being interrupted, this is the wrong role. If you want the scope of a lead without giving up the work, this is a good fit.


You are not being hired to stop writing code. The split is roughly 60% hands-on engineering, 40% leading technically and aligning.


What you’ll do

Build (approximately 60%)

  • Implement, maintain, and continuously improve a robust, scalable, high-performance backend and cloud infrastructure.
  • Take full ownership of architecture and software development across the full cycle, from prototype to production.
  • Ensure stable and reliable real-time data flow between buildings and the cloud, including monitoring and alerting.
  • Lead the reduction of technical debt and the consolidation of our platform.

Lead and align (approximately 40%)

  • Translate commercial and product priorities from the leadership team and internal stakeholders into technical work, and give an honest read on cost, risk, and sequencing before anything is committed. Write these down. Decisions here are made in short documents, not in meetings, and this bullet is most of what you will be writing.
  • Contribute to what we build, not only how. Product direction here is shaped by the people closest to the system, and you will be one of them.
  • Grow the team. You will define what we need, run technical interviews, make the call on candidates, and own whether people ramp up well.


The position

You report to the CTO (Aaron) and work alongside two senior software engineers (Sylvain and Tim). You are the technical authority on the platform and the day-to-day lead for the team.

We have no dedicated ops team (yet), so running your own services in production is part of the job. There is no on-call rotation.

This is a hybrid position based in Central Paris, 1-2 days per week on site. The alignment part of this role works better in person, and the people you will be translating for are here.


What you bring

  • Professional fluency in English (C1/C2).
  • Advanced programming skills in Python 3.12+, and JavaScript (or TypeScript).
  • Product judgment. You can tell the difference between a request and a requirement, and you have opinions about what should be built that you are willing to defend and to drop.
  • Senior-level experience building and operating back-end systems in critical production environments, including a period as tech lead, lead developer, or the de facto technical owner of a small team.
  • Working front-end experience. You do not need to be a front-end specialist, but you need to be able to ship a feature end-to-end without waiting for someone else, and to review front-end work credibly.
  • Ability to explain and trivialize technical subjects clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Real experience with GCP or an equivalent (AWS, Azure), or a clear willingness to get there fast.
  • Analytical and critical thinking, the ability to take responsibility for quality from prototype to production, and the ability to say no.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code and similar), including the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code and continuously improve internal procedures.
  • Comfort with a die and retry philosophy: fail fast in development, rigor in production.
  • A genuine interest in producing battle-tested, production-grade code within a distributed environment, and in staying current on software engineering and security.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you find solutions, take initiative, and accept that at our size responsibilities do not come in neat boxes.


Bonus points

  • High bonus: familiarity with IoT, MQTT, or building automation (HVAC).
  • High bonus: networking knowledge: routers, VLANs. You will be asked to handle those.
  • Ability to challenge existing architectures, including ones that have worked for years.
  • True fullstack experience (from prototype to production, any framework, any language) and the ability to maintain a production fleet.
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform.


You are curious and willing to learn. So are we. Even if you do not tick every box, we encourage you to apply.

Hinfact grandit vite et son SI interne a été construit au fil de l’eau : le parc Mac/iPad, les accès aux dizaines d’outils SaaS, l’arrivée et le départ des collaborateurs, et les preuves demandées par nos certifications ISO 9001 et ISO 27001 sont aujourd’hui gérés de façon dispersée. En parallèle, plusieurs outils internes — dont notre application de suivi des tickets — sont développés en interne et doivent être maintenus et étendus.


Nous créons ce poste pour confier à une seule personne la responsabilité de bout en bout du SI interne : le matériel, les accès, les outils que nous développons pour nous-mêmes, et la conformité qui va avec.


Vous ne serez pas seul·e. Vous rejoignez une squad transverse de quatre personnes, qui porte ensemble le socle technique et la conformité de l’entreprise :

  • un DevOps, qui opère notre infrastructure cloud (AWS, Kubernetes) et nos chaînes de déploiement ;
  • un DevSecOps, qui tient la sécurité applicative et le cœur technique de notre SMSI (ISO 27001) ;
  • un Responsable Qualité, qui porte le système de management de la qualité (ISO 9001) et nos process ;
  • et vous, sur le SI interne : postes de travail, identités et accès, outils internes, automatisation.

  • Les périmètres sont distincts mais les interfaces sont fortes : la gestion des accès que vous opérez alimente les preuves du DevSecOps, vos process d’onboarding sont ceux que le Responsable Qualité formalise, et vos outils internes s’appuient sur l’infrastructure du DevOps. C’est une squad où l’on avance ensemble sur les audits.


    Vos utilisateurs, eux, sont toute l’entreprise : Tech, Produit, Sales, Ops. Vous travaillerez aussi étroitement avec l’Office & HR Manager sur les arrivées et les départs.


    🎯 Vos missions :

    1. Parc matériel et logiciel — gérer le cycle de vie complet du parc Mac et iPad (achat, enrôlement MDM, inventaire, garanties, renouvellement, reconditionnement) ainsi que les licences et abonnements SaaS.
    2. Onboarding / offboarding — livrer un poste prêt à l’emploi le jour J (matériel, comptes, accès, SSO) et garantir une sortie propre : restitution du matériel, révocation immédiate des accès, traçabilité.
    3. Gestion des identités et des accès — administrer le SSO et les droits selon le principe du moindre privilège, et conduire les revues d’accès périodiques.
    4. Outils internes — maintenir et faire évoluer les applications développées en interne (suivi des tickets, et les suivantes) : recueil du besoin, développement, mise en production, support.
    5. Automatisation par l’IA — identifier les tâches manuelles répétitives dans toute l’entreprise, les industrialiser (scripts, agents, workflows) et diffuser ces usages auprès des équipes. C’est un axe stratégique du poste, pas un side project.
    6. Conformité ISO 9001 / 27001 — appliquer et maintenir les exigences sur le périmètre IT : inventaire des actifs, gestion des accès, sauvegardes, journalisation, gestion des incidents. Vous produisez les preuves de votre périmètre en binôme avec le Responsable Qualité sur le 9001 et le DevSecOps sur le 27001, et vous contribuez aux audits internes, de certification, et aux questionnaires sécurité de nos clients compagnies aériennes.
    7. Support IT interne — être le point d’entrée unique des incidents et des demandes, avec des délais de traitement annoncés et une base de connaissances tenue à jour.
    8. Budget et fournisseurs — piloter les achats, les contrats et le renouvellement des abonnements, et rationaliser les coûts.

    Le poste équilibre le run (parc, support, accès) et le build (outils internes, automatisation) : l’objectif est de contenir le run à environ la moitié du temps.

    • La maîtrise de la gestion des identités : Google Workspace, SSO/OIDC, MFA, provisioning et revue des droits ;
    • Le socle sécurité du poste de travail : chiffrement, EDR, sauvegardes, VPN, Wi-Fi ;

    • Une culture ISO 27001 : savoir ce qu’est un actif, un droit d’accès revu, une preuve d’audit.


    Si vous vous reconnaissez en plus dans les points suivants, alors nous avons très envie de vous rencontrer (Nice to have) :

    • Avoir contribué à un SMSI et vécu un audit de certification ISO 27001 ;
    • Une expérience de la démarche qualité ISO 9001 ;

    • Des notions AWS / Kubernetes, pour dialoguer avec le DevOps de la squad ;
